priority_note: docs/backend-gaps/INDEX.md sets priority per view. Every view is High. Individual rows have no priority of their own. Hint rows are unassigned until you accept them.

gaps.design_expects: Score out of 1000 plus a week-over-week point delta.
gaps.backend_today: GET /dashboard (crates/api/src/learning_services.rs build_dashboard) returns total_points, level, level_progress. mastery is always []. No 0-1000 index.
gaps.suggested: Add knowledge_score and knowledge_score_delta on GET /dashboard.
gaps.difference: total_points and level are a different metric (level n needs n*100 points). They cannot be shown as 884/1000.

gaps.design_expects: Estimated minutes to finish the due queue.
gaps.backend_today: due_today on GET /dashboard is a count of due items with overdue_days <= 0. DueQueueItem has no duration.
gaps.suggested: Add estimated_review_minutes on GET /dashboard or GET /due-queue.
gaps.difference: No per-card seconds model and no duration field anywhere on the queue or the session.

gaps.design_expects: Mastered count, weekly delta, and a long-term stability percent.
gaps.backend_today: MasteryRow exists on Dashboard (retention_estimate, recent_accuracy, due_count) but build_dashboard sets mastery to [].
gaps.suggested: Add mastered_count, mastered_delta, and stability_pct on GET /dashboard.
gaps.difference: The type is defined in crates/core/src/learning.rs and the field is on the response, but it is hard-coded empty. No mastered total, weekly delta, or stability percent is computed.

gaps.design_expects: Weekly change in the gold count.
gaps.backend_today: GET /questions?gold=true lists questions with is_gold. Question has created_at only, no gold_at. Dashboard has no gold fields.
gaps.suggested: Add gold_count and gold_delta on GET /dashboard.
gaps.difference: The current count can be derived from the gold list. A week-over-week delta cannot: nothing records when a question became gold.

gaps.design_expects: Category, chapter, syllabus percent, flashcard ratio, note count, and last studied time.
gaps.backend_today: Subject is id, name, description, created_at, updated_at (crates/core/src/lib.rs). No progress resource.
gaps.suggested: Add a subject progress resource: category, current chapter, completion, card counts, note count, last_studied_at.
gaps.difference: Sources, topics, and questions can be counted client-side, but category, chapter, completion, and last_studied_at are not stored.

gaps.design_expects: Open the current chapter.
gaps.backend_today: POST /sessions accepts subject_id and scope.source_ids/topic_ids (NewStudySession). No chapter entity and no resume target.
gaps.suggested: POST /study/sessions should accept a subject chapter, or GET /subjects/{id}/resume returns a session route.
gaps.difference: A subject or topic session can be started. There is no current-chapter pointer, so Resume cannot open a chapter. The suggested path /study/sessions does not exist; the live route is POST /sessions.

gaps.design_expects: Title, blurb, duration, question count, and a streak multiplier.
gaps.backend_today: GET /due-queue returns question_id, card_state, and overdue_days. No recommendation resource.
gaps.suggested: Add GET /due-queue/next-batch with title, reason, question_ids, estimated_minutes, points_multiplier.
gaps.difference: The client can take the first due cards. It cannot show a title, reason, duration, or points multiplier.

gaps.design_expects: Subject name, average stability, overdue count, and due count.
gaps.backend_today: GET /due-queue?subject_id= filters by joining questions, but DueQueueItem omits subject_id, subject_name, and question_title. No grouped route.
gaps.suggested: Include subject_id, subject_name, and question_title on each item, or add GET /due-queue/by-subject.
gaps.difference: Per-subject due counts and per-card stability exist only after one queue call per subject. A single queue response cannot be grouped, and there is no average-stability rollup.

gaps.design_expects: A future exam, countdown, readiness percent, target, and a configure action.
gaps.backend_today: FinalTest has created_at, started_at, submitted_at, score. recent_tests is the first 5 rows from FinalTestRepository::list, not a future exam. Goal is schema-only (no /goals route).
gaps.suggested: Add GET /tests/upcoming with scheduled_on, readiness, target_readiness, and PATCH to set the date.
gaps.difference: Past tests and an unused goals table exist. Nothing stores a scheduled exam date or a readiness score.

gaps.design_expects: A daily FSRS retention series and cards mastered that day.
gaps.backend_today: GET /daily-activity returns date, questions_answered, points_earned, minutes_studied, goal_met. accuracy_trend is points_earned / questions_answered. points_trend is the bar series.
gaps.suggested: Add retention and cards_mastered on each daily-activity row.
gaps.difference: The bars can use points_earned. There is no retention series and no per-day mastered count.

gaps.design_expects: A typed feed: upload, quiz, gold, review, with relative time.
gaps.backend_today: Sources, attempts, and points_ledger are separate. No activity route. Ledger reasons are only answer and override_compensation.
gaps.suggested: Add GET /activity?limit= with kind, title, detail, occurred_at.
gaps.difference: The client cannot build the typed feed. Attempts are not listable, and ledger rows have no title or kind such as upload, quiz, gold, or review.

gaps.design_expects: An accuracy label and a practice action per topic.
gaps.backend_today: weakest_topics is always [] in build_dashboard. POST /sessions scope.topic_ids already starts a topic session.
gaps.suggested: The gap doc asks for POST /study/sessions with topic_id. That route is unnecessary; topic scope already exists.
gaps.difference: The practice action can target a topic once a topic id is known. The dashboard never fills weakest_topics, so the accuracy label and the topic id are absent. The doc is wrong about the missing endpoint and right about the missing rows.

gaps.design_expects: Count of subjects that have cards scheduled today.
gaps.backend_today: due_today is one number. DueQueueItem has no subject_id. The page uses GET /subjects length.
gaps.suggested: Add subjects_due on GET /dashboard.
gaps.difference: N calls to GET /due-queue?subject_id= can count subjects with a non-empty queue. One dashboard or queue response cannot.

gaps.design_expects: A percent, a month-over-month delta, and a mastered/total card ratio.
gaps.backend_today: GET /subjects returns id, name, description, timestamps. Questions can be counted. No mastery fields.
gaps.suggested: Add mastery_pct, mastery_delta, mastered_count, and card_count on each subject.
gaps.difference: Card counts are derivable from GET /questions. Mastery percent, delta, and a mastered split are not stored or returned.

gaps.design_expects: Estimated minutes for the due queue, on the urgent card and on each subject.
gaps.backend_today: GET /due-queue?subject_id= returns due cards. No duration.
gaps.suggested: Add estimated_review_minutes on GET /due-queue.
gaps.difference: Same missing duration as overview-2 and reviews-4. Due count is live.

gaps.design_expects: A percent beside the gold count.
gaps.backend_today: GET /questions?gold=true returns the list. Attempts are not listable. No gold accuracy aggregate.
gaps.suggested: Add gold_accuracy on GET /dashboard.
gaps.difference: The count is client-side. Accuracy is not, because attempt scores are not exposed except inside a session or a submitted test.

gaps.design_expects: Discipline, level, and an archived flag, with counts.
gaps.backend_today: Subject has no category, level, or archived. Question status can be archived. Topic has is_core.
gaps.suggested: Add category, level, and archived on Subject.
gaps.difference: Archiving a question does not archive a subject. Tabs and tags have no columns.

gaps.design_expects: Order subjects by how due they are.
gaps.backend_today: Due counts require one GET /due-queue?subject_id= per subject. Subject has no due_count.
gaps.suggested: Add due_count on each subject so the client can sort without N requests.
gaps.difference: The number exists per subject after N queue calls. The list payload has no sort key.

gaps.design_expects: A history of file imports.
gaps.backend_today: GET /sources returns current sources with file_name, subject_id, status, created_at, ordered by created_at desc. Deleted rows are filtered out (deleted_at).
gaps.suggested: Add GET /sources/imports with file name, subject, status, and time.
gaps.difference: The live library is an import list of files that still exist. It is not a history: deleted imports disappear, and there is no import-event feed.

gaps.design_expects: Per-module percent and a Strong / Stable / Review label.
gaps.backend_today: GET /topics returns id, source_id, parent_id, title, position, is_core. No mastery.
gaps.suggested: Add mastery_pct and status on Topic.
gaps.difference: Topic tree metadata exists. The percent and the status label do not.

gaps.ui_element: Open subject and View all modules
gaps.design_expects: Open the syllabus and list every module.
gaps.backend_today: Topics are a tree per source (parent_id). No subject syllabus route. No chapter resource.
gaps.suggested: Add GET /subjects/{id}/syllabus with ordered modules, card counts, and mastery.
gaps.difference: The client can list topics per source. It cannot load one ordered subject syllabus with card counts and mastery.

gaps.design_expects: Used bytes and a local/cloud mirror label.
gaps.backend_today: Source has no byte size. Migration 005 creates stored_files.size_bytes, but no entity or route reads it. No quota.
gaps.suggested: Add bytes on Source and storage_used / storage_quota on a library summary.
gaps.difference: Upload size is enforced by MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES and then discarded. The library cannot show used or quota bytes.

gaps.design_expects: Create a source from a URL.
gaps.backend_today: POST /sources is multipart file upload only (crates/api/src/routes/sources.rs).
gaps.suggested: Add POST /sources/url with subject_id and url.
gaps.difference: No URL fetch, ArXiv fetch, or remote-document ingest exists.

gaps.design_expects: A flag that automatic FSRS tuning is on.
gaps.backend_today: GET /learning-settings returns desired_retention, caps, thresholds, points, and test_defaults. No tuning flag. No optimizer in the learning crate.
gaps.suggested: Add fsrs_auto_tune on GET /learning-settings.
gaps.difference: Nothing can turn automatic parameter tuning on, and nothing runs it.

gaps.design_expects: Encryption-at-rest and multi-device availability lines.
gaps.backend_today: GET /sync/status returns state, last_sync_at, message. Status is derived from whether a user is signed in; last_sync_at is always None (crates/api/src/routes/sync.rs). SyncDevice is a cursor key, not a device list. No encrypted flag.
gaps.suggested: Add encrypted and devices on the sync status, or drop the claims until they exist.
gaps.difference: Sync push, pull, and a status chip exist. The status does not report encryption or devices, and last_sync_at is not read from sync_cursors.

gaps.design_expects: File size, page count, and author.
gaps.backend_today: Source has title, kind (notes|book), file_name, status, progress. Chunk has page_ref. No bytes, page_count, or author.
gaps.suggested: Add bytes, page_count, and author on Source.
gaps.difference: kind and file_name can label a type. Size, page count, and author are not stored. page_ref on chunks is not a document page count.

gaps.design_expects: Percent retained and a monthly delta.
gaps.backend_today: Dashboard.mastery is []. accuracy_trend is points per answer, not a retention percent. desired_retention is a target, not an achieved rate.
gaps.suggested: Add a retention summary: current rate and delta versus the previous month.
gaps.difference: A target retention and a points-per-answer trend exist. An achieved retention percent and a monthly delta do not.

gaps.design_expects: Mean stability across the whole deck.
gaps.backend_today: GET /due-queue returns stability only for cards with due <= now. CardStateRepository::list_all exists in storage and has no HTTP route.
gaps.suggested: Add GET /cards or a deck summary with mean stability.
gaps.difference: The column is stored. No API returns the whole deck or a mean.

gaps.design_expects: Per-day projected card counts for the next week.
gaps.backend_today: due_queue loads list_due(as_of now) only. review_logs store scheduled_days. No forecast route.
gaps.suggested: Add a forecast of counts by local date for the next 7 days.
gaps.difference: Future dues are in card_states.due but the queue endpoint drops them, and nothing projects counts by local date.

gaps.design_expects: A minute estimate on the hero and on each subject queue.
gaps.backend_today: No duration on the queue or the session.
gaps.suggested: Add estimated_minutes on the due queue, or a per-card seconds model.
gaps.difference: Same missing duration as overview-2 and subjects-2.

gaps.design_expects: Download the review deck.
gaps.backend_today: GET /export returns subjects, settings, and profiles only (crates/api/src/routes/export.rs).
gaps.suggested: Add a deck export of cards (question, state, due, stability).
gaps.difference: An authenticated JSON export exists. It is not a deck: questions, card state, due, and stability are absent. Original files are also absent, despite the phase-5 export note.

gaps.design_expects: An uncapped session, and editable FSRS weights.
gaps.backend_today: NewStudySession.burst_size must be 1..=20. FsrsScheduler uses Parameters::default() and only overrides request_retention and enable_fuzz. Learning settings do not include a weight vector.
gaps.suggested: Add an uncapped review mode, and a weights payload only if the scheduler should be user-tuned.
gaps.difference: Review sessions exist and are capped at 20. Solver weights are the rs-fsrs defaults and are not readable or writable.

gaps.design_expects: A next milestone badge, such as 14 days.
gaps.backend_today: StreakInfo is current, longest, timezone (GET /streak and dashboard.streak). No milestone table.
gaps.suggested: Add milestone definitions, or drop the badge line.
gaps.difference: Current and longest streak are live. There is no next-badge definition.

gaps.design_expects: Drill that card.
gaps.backend_today: SessionScope is source_ids and topic_ids only. No question_ids.
gaps.suggested: Add question_ids on session scope.
gaps.difference: Practice can start for the card's topic or subject. It cannot be limited to that question.

gaps.design_expects: A retention percent beside the mastered count.
gaps.backend_today: Gold questions are listable. No mastered flag and no retention percent.
gaps.suggested: Add a retention rate for gold or mastered cards.
gaps.difference: A gold count is derivable. '99% retention' is the same missing achieved-retention metric as reviews-1.

gaps.design_expects: A percent and a 'final in N days' date.
gaps.backend_today: No projected grade. FinalTest has no scheduled date. Past scores exist only after submit.
gaps.suggested: Add a readiness summary and scheduled_for.
gaps.difference: A past score is not a projected grade, and there is no exam date. Same hole as overview-9 and final-tests-1/2.

gaps.design_expects: '6 of 10 answered' and a percent.
gaps.backend_today: StudySession has burst_size, started_at, ended_at, mode, scope. GET /sessions?subject_id= lists open sessions only. answered_ids is on GET /sessions/{id}/burst, not on the list.
gaps.suggested: Add answered_count on an open session.
gaps.difference: The count exists only after fetching each session's current burst. The list row the banner needs does not include it, and burst_size is not the quiz length.

gaps.design_expects: Multiple choice or written for this quiz.
gaps.backend_today: POST /sessions has no kind mix. questions::generate::cycle_kinds alternates MCQ and written. Test creation has TestKindMix; study sessions do not.
gaps.suggested: Add kinds on session create, or keep using question settings.
gaps.difference: Both kinds are generated, but the quiz screen cannot choose MCQ, written, or a mix for that session. Question settings have no kind percentages.

gaps.design_expects: A weak-topic scope and an application share of 0-50%.
gaps.backend_today: Session scope is source and topic ids. Cognitive mix is global on GET/PATCH /question-settings (recall, understand, apply, analyze must sum to 100).
gaps.suggested: Add a weak-topic scope and a per-session cognitive mix.
gaps.difference: The client can pass known topic ids. It cannot say 'all weak topics', and it cannot set an application share for one quiz without changing the global mix.

gaps.design_expects: A minute estimate and a duration editor.
gaps.backend_today: No duration and no time limit on a study session. Tests have time_limit_s.
gaps.suggested: Add estimated_minutes, or a time limit on the session.
gaps.difference: Study sessions are not timed. There is nothing to edit and nothing to estimate from.

gaps.design_expects: Category, due date, last score, targeted weak topics, and a preview.
gaps.backend_today: Due count is live. Topics are source topics with title and position. No recommendation payload.
gaps.suggested: Add a recommendation payload: category, due date, last score, weak topic ids.
gaps.difference: Due counts and topic titles can be shown. Category, a quiz due date, last score, and a preview are not returned.

gaps.design_expects: Past quizzes, pass/retry filters, pagination, review, and retake.
gaps.backend_today: No quiz resource. GET /sessions requires subject_id and returns open sessions only. GET /tests is a different route and is not paginated.
gaps.suggested: Add GET /quizzes with score, duration, concept, and a retake action.
gaps.difference: Open study sessions and final tests are listable. Finished quizzes, scores, pass/retry filters, and pagination are not.

gaps.design_expects: A scheduled exam date.
gaps.backend_today: FinalTest has created_at, started_at, submitted_at. No scheduled_for. Subject has no exam date.
gaps.suggested: Add scheduled_for on the test, or a subject exam date.
gaps.difference: The list can show when a test was created or submitted. It cannot show a future exam date.

gaps.design_expects: A percent, a band, and a monthly delta.
gaps.backend_today: score and pass are set only after submit. No projection and no monthly delta.
gaps.suggested: Add a readiness summary from recent attempts.
gaps.difference: A submitted score is not a projection, and nothing compares this month to last month.

gaps.design_expects: A percent and covered/total topic counts.
gaps.backend_today: Topics hang off a source. Test results include a topic_breakdown of answered questions only. No coverage rollup.
gaps.suggested: Add covered and total topic counts for a subject.
gaps.difference: The client can count topics. It cannot know which topics are covered by notes or by questions.

gaps.design_expects: 'Question 14 of 35' for an in-progress test.
gaps.backend_today: GET /tests returns FinalTest with no answered index. TestDetail is the test plus QuestionPublic rows, still with no answered ids. Attempts are attached in GET /tests/{id}/results after submit.
gaps.suggested: Add answered_count on an in-progress test.
gaps.difference: Answers are stored while the test is in progress, and the full set is visible after submit. The list and the detail used for Resume do not expose how far the learner got.

gaps.design_expects: Full exam, midterm, or short quiz.
gaps.backend_today: TestConfig has question_count, time_limit_s, kinds, cognitive_mix, and focus_mode. No format.
gaps.suggested: Add format, or drop the control.
gaps.difference: Count and time limit are separate fields. They do not record a named format.

gaps.design_expects: Time spent of the limit, and exit counts.
gaps.backend_today: The list has time_limit_s and integrity_status (clean, flagged, unverified). TestResults.time_taken_s and integrity_timeline exist only on GET /tests/{id}/results. Timeline events have kind and at, not a duration or an exit total.
gaps.suggested: Add time_taken_s and an exit count on the list row.
gaps.difference: After submit, time taken and the event list can be loaded per test. The history table cannot show them, and exit events are not counted or given durations.

gaps.design_expects: A test name plus a syllabus slice.
gaps.backend_today: FinalTest has no title. Config JSON has subject_id, source_ids, and topic_ids.
gaps.suggested: Add title on the test.
gaps.difference: The subject name can be joined. A test name and a syllabus-slice label are not stored.

gaps.design_expects: A semester window beside 7 days, 30 days, and all time.
gaps.backend_today: GET /daily-activity accepts from and to. No semester start on the profile or settings.
gaps.suggested: Add a semester start date on the profile or settings.
gaps.difference: The client can filter a date range. It has no stored boundary that defines the semester.

gaps.design_expects: A downloadable analytics report.
gaps.backend_today: GET /export is subjects, settings, and profiles. No PDF or analytics snapshot.
gaps.suggested: Add an analytics export, or drop the button.
gaps.difference: The existing export is not an analytics report. Same endpoint limitation as reviews-5, different payload.

gaps.design_expects: A percent, a monthly delta, and a recall curve versus the target.
gaps.backend_today: No retention series. accuracy_trend is points per answer. desired_retention is the target only.
gaps.suggested: Add retention by elapsed day, plus a current rate and delta.
gaps.difference: The target line could be drawn from desired_retention. The actual curve, the current rate, and the delta cannot.

gaps.design_expects: '342 of 410' and coverage.
gaps.backend_today: Topics exist per source. No mastered flag. Due count is separate.
gaps.suggested: Add mastered and total concept counts.
gaps.difference: Topic and question totals are countable. 'Mastered' is not defined in stored data.

gaps.design_expects: '884 / 1,000' and a band.
gaps.backend_today: total_points and level are not a 1,000-point score. No band.
gaps.suggested: Add a bounded knowledge score, or show points as points.
gaps.difference: Same missing index as overview-1. Points and level are live and are a different scale.

gaps.design_expects: Hours per subject, a modality mix, and a peak window.
gaps.backend_today: daily_activity.minutes_studied is per user-local day. It is not split by subject, modality, or hour of day.
gaps.suggested: Add subject minutes, modality, and a peak-hour summary.
gaps.difference: Total study minutes for a range can be summed. The subject split, modality mix, and peak window cannot.

gaps.design_expects: Reviews, quizzes, gold, and streak shares.
gaps.backend_today: GET /points-ledger returns amount, reason (answer or override_compensation), attempt_id, test_id, and multiplier_breakdown (base, score, gold, streak, test, anti-farm).
gaps.suggested: Add a reason per surface, or a breakdown endpoint.
gaps.difference: Gold and streak factors are inside each row's breakdown, and test_id separates test awards. Nothing labels reviews versus quizzes, and there is no aggregated share endpoint.

gaps.design_expects: Mastery, a stability band, a lapse filter, and details.
gaps.backend_today: Due cards have stability and lapses. Topics have title and is_core. No topic mastery score. No lapse-filter query.
gaps.suggested: Add topic mastery and a lapse filter.
gaps.difference: Stability and lapses can be shown for topics that have a due card. Non-due topics are invisible, and there is no mastery score or 30-day lapse filter.

gaps.design_expects: Three subject lines across dated exams. The gap doc says to keep the sample only for the empty state.
gaps.backend_today: GET /tests returns subject_id, score, pass, submitted_at, and integrity_status for every test. GET /subjects supplies the name.
gaps.suggested: No backend change. Plot live scores. Keep the sample only when no test is scored.
gaps.difference: The gap doc is right that an empty list has no series, and wrong that this needs an API. The chart can be built from GET /tests joined to GET /subjects. One score per test is enough for a dated point. The sample belongs in the empty state only.

gaps.design_expects: A forecast such as 'about 28 cards a day' at the chosen retention.
gaps.backend_today: due_today is the queue due now. No projection for a proposed desired_retention.
gaps.suggested: Add a projected daily load for a retention target.
gaps.difference: Changing the slider cannot preview load. The live due count is a different number.

gaps.design_expects: w0–w16 and a '17 weights configured' count, including reset.
gaps.backend_today: LearningSettings has no weight vector. FsrsScheduler uses rs-fsrs Parameters::default() and does not read or write w.
gaps.suggested: Add the weight vector on GET/PATCH /learning-settings.
gaps.difference: Retention is configurable. The 17 weights are not visible, editable, or resettable.

gaps.design_expects: Days per subject, such as 180 or 365.
gaps.backend_today: No maximum_interval_days on learning settings or on the scheduler call.
gaps.suggested: Add maximum_interval_days on learning settings, including subject overrides.
gaps.difference: Subject overrides exist for the current learning keys only. Interval cap is not one of them.

gaps.design_expects: Per-subject retention override, an editor, and an exam countdown.
gaps.backend_today: PATCH /learning-settings?subject_id= writes subject:{id}:learning_* and GET returns ResolvedLearningSettings.sources so an override can be detected. LearningSettingsPatch has no clear. No exam date.
gaps.suggested: Add a clear-override call and an exam date on the subject.
gaps.difference: Setting a retention override already works, and the response says whether the value came from the subject. The override cannot be cleared back to the user default, and the exam chip has no date.

gaps.design_expects: One masked key with show, change, and test ping.
gaps.backend_today: Keys live on each AiProvider (has_api_key, api_key_hint). POST /ai-providers/test and POST /ai-providers/default exist. The raw key is never returned. Cloud AI uses CLOUD_AI_API_KEY from the environment, not a stored gateway key.
gaps.suggested: Add a single gateway credential, or keep the provider form as the editor.
gaps.difference: Masked per-provider keys and a connection test exist. There is no single workspace gateway credential, and no API returns a key that could be shown.

gaps.design_expects: Tier, reset date, auto-reload, and buy.
gaps.backend_today: GET /credits/balance is balance, reserved, available and requires a signed-in user. POST /credits/topup is MockPaymentProvider with amount_credits and idempotency_key. No plan, reset, or auto-reload.
gaps.suggested: Add plan, reset date, and auto-reload. 401 when signed out.
gaps.difference: Balance and a mock top-up exist. Tier, reset date, auto-reload, and the 'credits never expire' versus monthly-reset conflict in the designs are not modeled. Signed-out calls 401 today.

gaps.design_expects: Named tasks, chapter details, and a CSV. The design labels this an audit log of cloud processing.
gaps.backend_today: GET /credits/ledger rows are id, user_id, amount, kind (topup|usage|refund|adjustment), reference, created_at. usage_events store provider, model, kind, tokens. No task title and no CSV route.
gaps.suggested: Add task title and detail, plus GET /credits/ledger.csv.
gaps.difference: A signed-in ledger exists. Rows are not named tasks with chapter detail, and there is no CSV.

gaps.design_expects: A memory-model timestamp.
gaps.backend_today: Learning settings are rows in the settings table, which has updated_at, but GET /learning-settings does not return a timestamp. No schedule_updated_at.
gaps.suggested: Add schedule_updated_at on learning settings or the dashboard.
gaps.difference: The client would have to guess which settings-row timestamp is the memory-model cycle. That field is not defined.

gaps.design_expects: Local, bring-your-own key, and app-credit cloud as the stored mode.
gaps.backend_today: GET /ai-providers returns a list. Kinds are openai_compatible, ollama, and mock. CloudProvider is selected from env when a signed-in call uses cloud AI. Nothing stores the active product mode.
gaps.suggested: Add a workspace inference mode, separate from provider records.
gaps.difference: Local (Ollama), bring-your-own-key (OpenAI-compatible), and cloud providers can all exist. The screen's single selected mode is not stored. This row is in docs/backend-gaps/settings.md and is not tagged BACKEND_GAP in the frontend.

gaps.design_expects: Per-file stages Uploading, Reading, Sections, Indexing, Questions, with cancel, retry, and OCR retry. Add Material also offers DOCX and 'generate questions automatically'.
gaps.backend_today: Source status is pending|processing|ready|failed plus one progress integer. spawn_ingest updates 5, 20, 50, then ready or failed. POST /sources/{id}/reembed retries embeddings only. Parsers are txt, md, pdf, epub. parser_for('file.docx') is None. No OCR.
gaps.suggested: Not in the gap docs. Design: design-system/add_material_self_study_ai/code.html and the library row 'Failed: retry'.
gaps.difference: A file-level status and a re-embed action exist. Named stages, cancel, stage retry, OCR, DOCX, and an ingest-time generate toggle do not.

gaps.design_expects: A cited answer over the learner's notes, with follow-up, copy, and save-as-card. The syllabus screen has an Ask your notes action.
gaps.backend_today: POST /search returns SearchHit chunks (text, source, topic, page_ref, score). No generated answer.
gaps.suggested: Not in the gap docs. Design: design-system/search_results_self_study_ai/code.html and the syllabus Ask your notes link.
gaps.difference: Cited passages exist. A composed answer with citation markers, follow-up, and save-as-card does not.

gaps.design_expects: Four rating buttons with a next-interval preview, plus Bury until tomorrow and Edit card.
gaps.backend_today: ReviewRating is again|hard|good|easy. score_to_rating maps an attempt score using learning_rating_thresholds. schedule() returns scheduled_days, which is stored on review_logs and not returned as a preview. AnswerResponse is attempt, question, low_confidence. No bury column. PATCH /questions/{id} can edit a question.
gaps.suggested: Not in the gap docs. Design: design-system/flashcard_review_self_study_ai/code.html.
gaps.difference: Grading already picks a rating and schedules the next due date after the answer is submitted. The screen needs the four intervals before the learner rates, a direct rating, and bury. Edit card can use the existing question update.

gaps.design_expects: Re-estimate w0–w16 from the learner's review log, and reset to defaults.
gaps.backend_today: review_logs store rating, scheduled_days, and elapsed_days. No optimizer and no weight columns.
gaps.suggested: Not in the gap docs. Design: design-system/settings_study_fsrs_self_study_ai/code.html. Editing the weights is settings-2; this is the optimizer action.
gaps.difference: The review log is kept for a future optimizer, as phase 4 described, and no optimizer is implemented.

gaps.design_expects: Per-question points, a weighted rubric, model answer, omissions, integrity exit times, export report, and generate cards from mistakes.
gaps.backend_today: GET /tests/{id}/results returns score, pass, time_taken_s, per-question attempt (score, verdict, feedback.corrections/additions/missing_points/model_answer), topic_breakdown, and integrity_timeline (kind, at, meta).
gaps.suggested: Not in the gap docs. Design: design-system/final_exam_results_distributed_systems_self_study_ai/code.html and the exam workspace rubric checklist.
gaps.difference: A graded transcript with feedback and an integrity timeline already exists. Criterion weights, point totals out of 100, exit durations, a results PDF, and 'create cards from mistakes' do not. The in-exam rubric checklist is also absent and conflicts with the answer-leak rule unless it is criteria only.
